d: France said on Monday it has opened an investigation into an Iranian cyber unit affiliated with the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps over cyberattacks that targeted supermarket refrigerators last month. French foreign minister vows sanctions against Iran 'on European level' over fridge cyberattacks. Iran has previously denied any role in such malicious activities. Hundreds of supermarkets across France were targeted in an unprecedented cyberattack that remotely overrode internet-connected refrigeration and freezer systems, causing temperatures to soar up to 50C (122F) or higher and…
